title: Agent Node Creation Process
definition: The structured sequence of steps used to define, validate, and generate a CID for an AgentNode.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine building a LEGO model. You first plan out each piece, then check if they fit together correctly. Once everything is in place, you assign a unique number to your creation, so it can be easily found and referenced.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: AgentNode creation process involves defining agent purpose and execution specification, validating schema compliance, semantic consistency, content, and generating a unique CID using the IPLD format.
difficulty_levels.expert: AgentNode creation process is a novel approach that combines the principles of IPLD and JSON Schema to create a universal schema for intelligent agents. It allows for the validation of agent specifications at different levels, from syntactic compliance to semantic consistency. By generating a unique CID for each agent, it enables the creation of a graph-like network of interconnected agents.

extra_fields.insight: The AgentNode creation process provides a universal schema and validation system for intelligent agents, enabling the creation of a graph-like network of interconnected agents.
